title: image-copy: redraw screencopy buffers that were never painted
body:
I ran into this issue where video buffers were not being piped to shared memory buffers, which breaks screen sharing/capture. I don't know enough about this kind of stuff to fix it manually so I had grok come up with a small fix for it. 

I know the policy is no LLM code, but I've validated this fix manually and reviewed the code and it seems fairly clean. 

Feel free to close this PR and re-use the code or just implement your own fix if you want, I just want OBS + screen sharing to work again :S 

Related to:

- https://github.com/pop-os/xdg-desktop-portal-cosmic/issues/367
- https://github.com/pop-os/cosmic-comp/issues/1750

https://github.com/pop-os/xdg-desktop-portal-cosmic/issues/286 is a separate portal crash and is not addressed here.
